question: Do the available 1961-2021 agricultural source histories support a mass-conserving and numerically identifiable test of manure-associated source-zone SON retention, distinct from generic equal-mass storage and all-source SON12?
allowed_work: audit the frozen reach-year and reach-month agricultural N ledgers
audit current code and data provenance for Q72-only water information
recheck municipal WWTP non-overlap without activating WWTP mass
search and synthesize peer-reviewed nitrogen-Legacy literature
use station/reach/time identifiers without reading TN values
forbidden_work: fit or score any new candidate against observed TN
change Q72, H1, source timing, mu, T1, R0 or readout
add temperature, SAS, groundwater age, second soil pool, reservoir process or WWTP
estimate a real manure mineralization rate from the synthetic test
claim field-scale validation from model-internal states

registered_structures.AGG_MOBILE_PARENT: all positive net diffuse surplus enters the existing aggregate mobile source-zone pool; no SON12 allocation
registered_structures.ALL_SOURCE_SON12: all positive net diffuse surplus enters the fixed 12-month SON pool
registered_structures.GENERIC_MATCHED_SON12: phi_M times an equal-mass basin-year generic allocation enters SON12; its basin-year slow mass exactly matches MANURE_ASSOC_SON12
registered_structures.MANURE_ASSOC_SON12: phi_M times the proportional manure-associated share of positive net diffuse surplus enters SON12

source_partition.manure_associated_potential: M_star = S_plus * manure / G when G > 0, else 0
source_partition.mass_match: sum_r(G_star_r_y_m) = sum_r(M_remaining_star_r_y_m) for every month with positive remaining basin surplus

required_checks: source ledger completeness and annual-to-month closure
operator mass balance and exact phi_M=0 nesting
pairwise process-signal correlations and normalized distances
profile recovery of generating structure and phi_M under registered synthetic noise
confounding with the six frozen transport-memory mu members

synthetic_generation.noise: independent Normal(0, 0.20) perturbation on log1p concentration
synthetic_generation.nuisance_readout: bounded 0-1 eta_quick and eta_gw refitted for every candidate using station-equal weights
synthetic_generation.selection_score: station-equal weighted RMSE on log1p synthetic concentration

synthetic_preflight.identifiability_gate: MANURE_ASSOC must be distinguishable from GENERIC_MATCHED at monitoring support in at least 80% of registered synthetic replicates for phi_M >= 0.25, with median absolute phi_M error <= 0.10; otherwise formal source-identity fitting is not authorized
